constraint_residual_definition: Within each translation/rotation and BEAM/BC row group: max(abs(C_group u))/max(abs(C_group) abs(u)); zero/zero=0. Initial algebraic diagnostic only, not a dimensional energy norm or active-tangent validation.
limitations: Raw ODB was not read; its reported hash and source-stability claim cannot be independently checked from this archive.
Coordinate tolerance is exporter matching tolerance; coordinates are stored as float64 but appear quantized by source output.
Eigenvalues come from exported descriptions; extra digits are not reconstructed and stress units are not inferred.
Initial BEAM/BC residuals do not establish active contact, S4R stiffness, material/load/history equivalence or mFSM family classification.
